about: Pure-Ergo gofacts fact/effect SoA tables, guard ledger checks, hostguard purity/handle checks, and source hashing.

mutants.name: selfhost-gobind-gofacts-row-digest-drops-view
mutants.from:
LineDigest("fact " + RowKey(r) + "
source " + r.Source + "
reason " + r.Reason + "
view " + strconv.FormatBool(r.View) + "
go " + toolchain + "
")
mutants.to:
LineDigest("fact " + RowKey(r) + "
source " + r.Source + "
reason " + r.Reason + "
view " + strconv.FormatBool(false && r.View) + "
go " + toolchain + "
")
mutants.rule: RowDigest must encode r.View into the hashed row digest so zero-copy view eligibility is guarded.

mutants.name: selfhost-gobind-gofacts-ledger-skips-toolchain
mutants.rule: Acts must reject ledger guard lines whose recorded toolchain differs from the running toolchain.

mutants.name: selfhost-gobind-gofacts-ledger-first-line-wins
mutants.rule: Ledger parsing obeys last-line-wins per fact key.

mutants.name: selfhost-gobind-gofacts-hostguard-handle-reopen
mutants.rule: Once closed, a HandleModel rejects all subsequent operations with os.ErrClosed.

mutants.name: selfhost-gobind-gofacts-hostguard-pure-allows-denied-member
mutants.rule: CheckPureImports must reject host-touching members of packages in PureImportHostMembers.

mutants.name: selfhost-gobind-gofacts-source-includes-test-files
mutants.rule: SourceHashDir skips _test.go files when hashing target declarations.
